title: Automated flows
subtitle: See each flow's entry message in English and Arabic, and the approval status of every version.
info.title: How Arabic versions work in flows
info.sending: Arabic versions are prepared and tracked here; automatic sending of Arabic versions by flows is switched on separately. Until then, customers receive the English message.
info.approval: Each Arabic version must be approved by WhatsApp and reviewed by a native Arabic speaker before it can be used.
empty: You don't have any automated flows yet.
trigger.label: Trigger
sameButtons: Button labels in every language must keep the same number and order as the English message. The editor locks this for you.
noArabicYet: No Arabic version yet. Customers who speak Arabic will receive the English message.
info.sendingLive: When a customer who speaks Arabic is due a flow message, WaFlow sends the Arabic version if WhatsApp has approved it and a native Arabic speaker has reviewed it. Otherwise the customer receives the English message.
info.followUps: Follow-up replies (what a customer gets after tapping a button) are free replies: they need no WhatsApp approval, only a native review. If you change the English text afterwards, the Arabic version is marked out of date and stops sending until you review it again.
defaultTemplate.note: This flow sends a fixed English message that is shared by every WaFlow workspace, so it has no Arabic version. To send Arabic from this flow, pick a Promotion for it and add that promotion's Arabic version.
node.notFound: We couldn't find that message in your flows. It may have been removed.
stale.title: The Arabic version is out of date
stale.entry: The English message changed after the Arabic version was written. Check the Arabic text and update it if needed.
stale.followUp: The English reply changed after the Arabic text was written. Customers receive the English reply until you check the Arabic text, save it and mark it as reviewed again.
editor.title: Arabic version of this reply
editor.bodyHint: Write it the way a Saudi shop would say it. Use the merge field buttons above to insert the customer's name and other details.
editor.labelsHint: Each button keeps its place and what it does. Only the label changes (at most {max} characters).
editor.slotProblem: The English text uses fields that cannot be copied over automatically. Write the Arabic text yourself using the merge fields shown.
editor.reviewHint: Ask a native Arabic speaker to read the text, then mark it as reviewed. Only reviewed text is sent to customers.
editor.saveStaleFirst: Save the Arabic text again to confirm it still matches the English reply, then mark it as reviewed.
editor.saveFailed: We couldn't save the Arabic text.
editor.reviewFailed: We couldn't change the review status.
editor.conflict: This text was changed somewhere else after you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.
issue.unknown: Something in this text needs attention.
issue.unbalanced_braces: A merge field has a missing or extra curly bracket.
issue.meta_positional_syntax: Use the merge field buttons instead of numbered fields.
issue.body_too_long: The text is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.followup_unknown_field: The merge field "{field}" can't be used in this reply.
issue.followup_button_mismatch: The buttons don't match the English reply. Reload and try again.
issue.button_label_empty: Every button needs an Arabic label.
issue.button_label_too_long: A button label is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
issue.duplicate_button_label: Two buttons have the same label.
issue.followup_field_dropped: The English reply uses the field "{field}" but the Arabic text does not.
sample.name: Sara
promoMessages.title: Promotion messages - not used by a flow
promoMessages.note: These promotions send their own message from the Promotions screen, without a flow. Add the Arabic version of the message and of its follow-up replies here.
promoMessages.truncated: Only the newest {count} promotions are shown.
